models.specVerification: Ferrari S.p.A. 2011 brochure, PDF page34 (printed62-63), extracted using pypdf and visually verified 2026-11-07. 1535kg kerb,1430kg dry; dimensions4527/1937/1211mm, wheelbase2650mm. models.variantNote: The distributor calls the asset Ferrari 458 Italia; browser visual inspection shows the open-roof Spider form. UI and reference mass therefore use 458 Spider, while attribution preserves the original title.
models.referenceMassType: Kerb weight; forged rims and racing seat
